causes.signal_label: 半导体ETF创历史最佳月度表现
causes.description: 半导体ETF SOXX录得25年来最大月度回报，SMH录得自2003年11月以来最佳月度表现。本轮上涨由Intel、AMD、Micron和Marvell等芯片股驱动，而非前周期的AI硬件龙头Nvidia。
causes.evidence_text: SOXX posts its largest monthly return in 25 years. SMH had its best month since November 2003. Yet Nvidia — the AI hardware leader of the prior cycle — was the slowest-moving mega-cap chipmaker in the basket. Intel, AMD, Micron and Marvell did the work.

logic_frame.what_changed: 半导体ETF SOXX和SMH分别录得25年来最大月度回报和自2003年11月以来最佳月度表现，且上涨由Intel、AMD、Micron、Marvell驱动，而非Nvidia。

causes.description: Akamai Technologies发布新研究，指出随着组织加速API部署而缺乏足够安全措施，API安全存在显著漏洞。API安全影响调查报告显示，针对API的网络攻击明显增加，大多数组织受到影响。研究将API暴露的增加与AI驱动平台的广泛部署联系起来，API通常位于数据访问和模型集成的核心。
causes.evidence_text: Akamai Technologies (NasdaqGS:AKAM) released new research highlighting significant security gaps as organizations accelerate API deployment without sufficient safeguards. The API Security Impact Survey reports a marked rise in API focused cyberattacks, with incidents affecting a large majority of organizations.

logic_frame.what_changed: Akamai发布新研究，报告API安全漏洞显著增加，且与AI平台部署相关。

causes.description: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor发布了面向AI服务器和高端GPU的SmartClamp™ Protected DrMOS系列，该技术提供行业领先的峰值电流限制，确保高需求AI工作负载的安全可靠运行。
causes.evidence_text: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Unveils SmartClamp™ Protected DrMOS Family for AI Servers and High-End GPUs. New DrMOS technology delivers industry-leading peak-to-peak current limiting, ensuring safe and reliable operation for high-demand AI workloads...

causes.description: Akamai发布新研究，指出随着组织加速API部署且缺乏足够安全措施，API安全漏洞显著增加。API安全影响调查报告显示，针对API的网络攻击明显上升，大多数组织受到影响。研究将API暴露增加与AI驱动平台的广泛推广联系起来，API通常位于数据访问和模型集成的核心位置。
causes.evidence_text: Akamai Technologies (NasdaqGS:AKAM) released new research highlighting significant security gaps as organizations accelerate API deployment without sufficient safeguards. The API Security Impact Survey reports a marked rise in API focused cyberattacks, with incidents affecting a large majority of organizations. The findings link growing API exposure to the broader rollout of AI powered platforms, where APIs often sit at the core of data access and model integration.

logic_frame.what_changed: Akamai发布新研究，揭示API安全漏洞显著增加，且与AI平台扩张相关。
